data.narrative:
Span is a Series C-stage climate and energy company that has raised approximately $419M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of nine private companies and one public comparable (LNZA) operating in the climate and energy sector, with particular focus on three same-stage private peers: KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $419M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.7x multiplier typical for Series C to next-stage advancement, yielding $712M. Peer-median analysis references the median valuation of three same-sector, same-stage comparables at $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M (Amogy) to $3.0B (KoBold Metals). The peer cohort exhibits material valuation dispersion, reflecting varying technology maturity and market positioning within the climate technology segment.

These two methods triangulate to a valuation range of $605M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median point of $856M. The stage-progression method anchors toward the lower end of the range, while peer-median positioning supports valuations toward $1.0B. Key uncertainties include the appropriate step-up multiplier for this specific stage transition and the relevance of the KoBold outlier ($3.0B) relative to Span's specific technology and market position. Revenue traction, path to unit economics, and capital efficiency relative to named peers would materially refine this range.
